copy.test_name: writes the value to the clipboard and flips to Copied
copy.requirement: Clicking CopyButton with value 019f2866-2172-7696-9166-c69f309a559a and label Copy workspace ID must write exactly that value to navigator.clipboard.writeText. Writing the label instead is incorrect even if the button shows Copied.
copy.witness: The isolated incorrect implementation writes Copy workspace ID instead of the supplied value.

classes.test_name: test_ds_cn_merges_and_keeps_fontsize — a semantic font-size token survives beside a color token
classes.requirement: cn("text-eyebrow", "text-muted-foreground") must return exactly "text-eyebrow text-muted-foreground", retaining the semantic font size alongside the color. Returning only the color is incorrect.
classes.witness: The isolated incorrect implementation omits text-eyebrow from the font-size class group, so the color wins and drops the size.

relative.test_name: crosses out of 'just now' at exactly 5 s ago
relative.requirement: For now 2026-05-03T12:00:00Z and a timestamp exactly 5000 milliseconds earlier, formatTimeRelative must return exactly "5 seconds ago". The "just now" band excludes that boundary; returning "just now" is incorrect.
relative.witness: The isolated incorrect implementation includes exactly five seconds in the just-now band.

elapsed.test_name: should spell elapsed time to the second, as Intl's narrow duration does
elapsed.requirement: formatElapsed(59600) must round to the nearest second and return exactly "1m 0s". Returning "59s" by flooring is incorrect even though it is a well-shaped duration.
elapsed.witness: The isolated incorrect implementation floors milliseconds-to-seconds instead of rounding.
